focus: Q1: overlay-engine.cjs correctness and safety for protectedPaths, repin.exclude, the not-copied list, partial failure and rollback
answeredQuestions: Q1: Where is overlay-engine.cjs (status/apply/capture/repin/rollback) incorrect or unsafe against its own docs and tests, for example manifest drift, protectedPaths and repin.exclude handling, the not-copied list, partial failure and rollback?

graphEvents.label: Dotenv-prefix heuristic blocks .env.example and .envrc with no escape hatch
Repin refuses when an upstream-deleted file is already missing locally
Not-copied list omits upstream additions at absent top-level paths
Not-copied findings are ephemeral and never re-surfaced by status
Interrupted repin leaves no durable run status or rollback pointer
Not-copied summary appends AGENTS.md guidance to unrelated paths
Rollback restores the pin because the manifest is backed up
Backup and copy share one touched-path list

label: isEnvName matches any basename starting with .env, and protectedPathsFor refuses .env names, so a directory or skill-root overlay containing .env.example or .envrc is permanently blocked with the remedy 'move it out of the overlay'.

unownedDrift treats a touched delete path that is already absent from the tree as drift ('missing from the tree') and refuses the re-pin; the printed remedies (overlay, repin.exclude, restore from old pin) do not fit an already-deleted file.

notCopiedChanges gates on holdsRealTopLevel, which returns false when the top-level path is absent, so an upstream addition of a brand-new top-level file is neither copied nor listed, contradicting the docs' 'What a re-pin leaves out, it lists'.

The not-copied list is computed only for oldCommit..newCommit and stored only in that run's report.json, so status never re-surfaces an excluded path's drift and a later re-pin's diff no longer contains it.

report.json is written only after the run finishes and the rollback line is printed only from the in-process failure path, so a killed re-pin leaves a half-migrated tree with no durable run status and no way to list repin-runs from the CLI.
reportNotCopied appends '(AGENTS.md sections: /doctor:agents-md)' to every not-copied summary, even when the listed paths are README, CI workflow or docs changes unrelated to AGENTS.md.
A failed re-pin is reversible including the pin: writeBackup adds ctx.manifestPath and ctx.statePath to enginePaths before writePin runs, and rollbackUnderLock restores them.
No path is written before it is backed up: touchedPaths is computed once and drives both the backup groups and the copy/delete writes.

direction: Hypothesis that repin --rollback restores file bytes but leaves pin.commit advanced, leaving the tree inconsistent after recovery.
reason: Refuted by writeBackup adding ctx.manifestPath and ctx.statePath to enginePaths and rollbackUnderLock restoring them; the repin rollback test asserts a byte-for-byte tree that passes status.
